_metric_glossary.n_retrieved: events with GT in retrieved Top-K (n_total * inclusion)
_metric_glossary.retrieval_inc: fraction of slice events where GT in Top-K
_metric_glossary.within_pool_cov: GT in conformal set | GT in Top-K
_metric_glossary.avg_set_size_within_pool: avg |C(u)| restricted to events where GT in Top-K
_metric_glossary.gap_global: max-min of within_pool_cov across all slices (any dim)
_metric_glossary.is_post_hoc_diagnostic: True if slice uses GT-derived value (not deployable)
